name: Ray Blackwell
original_name: レイ ブラックウェル
source:
Cool & Popular

The young King of the Black Army hates being tied down and values freedom above all else. He is stoic and candid with everyone he meeds, and is popular with Cradle citizens of all ages. Despite his brisk demeanor, he has a soft spot for cats.

"Don't cry, no matter how awful your luck is. I'll be right there, fighting beside you."

[Official in-game description]
